name: Seller Weekly
office_task: Every Monday, publish each seller a report on their listing: buyer enquiries, inspections and online views, every figure traced to its source, for the listing agent to send.
systems_of_record: the agency's sales CRM (such as Rex, VaultRE or Agentbox) that holds buyer enquiries and online listing views, issuing the listing_id
the inspection register the agency keeps for open homes and private inspections
the agency's report store or vendor portal the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the week's report per audience: each seller sees only their own listing's figures, the agency principal sees every listing; each figure carries its definition id, source and as-of time, and a correction is a new version superseding the old with the named person and the reason. Sending a seller's view to the seller stays with the listing agent
emits.readback: reading the week's reports back from the report store returns each report_id with its version, audience, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and an exception is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a source that could not be read, a measure with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared, or an incomplete correction
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the week, the measure, the reason and the exception_owner

port_of.original_name: Send weekly seller property reports from Google Sheets via Gmail
